theorems.name: Submission.tdo_ods_norm_sub_le_integral_deriv
theorems.statement: ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (W : ℝ → Rn ℓ) (a : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith K W (Icc (-a) a) → ∀ s ∈ Icc (-a) a, ∀ t ∈ Icc (-a) a, ‖W t - W s‖ ≤ ∫ r in Ioo (-a) a, ‖deriv W r‖
